QuestInfo.1: You ran into the Yellow M-Forcer near Omega Sector. She already knew that you helped the Alien Gray, so you must make an effort to make up if you don't want to be treated as a hostile! You must defeat 100 #r#o4230118##k aliens to regain their trust. #o4230118# can be found in #b#m221040300##k and #b#m221040400##k.
QuestInfo.2: I may have helped out Alien Gray in a moment of chaos, but after successfully completing the mission Yellow M-Forcer gave me, I think I regained some of her trust. It just seems like the aliens do not want to peacefully coexist with us.

0.0: Hmmm... Aren't you... the one that helped #b#p2050002##k out the other day? This is serious stuff... I heard about an alien that trick the people into fishing out classified information on us, but I thought they were just rumors... not in real life.
0.1: It's only a matter of time before the Sector finds out about this, and who knows? You may be classified as an alien-supporter, too. Well, but then again, you really didn't know any better... What do you think? Would you like to take on my mission to regain at least my trust?

yes.0: Good choice. You never know when you're going to be classified as an enemy of the Sector. Your task is simple. Just show it to us that you're NOT an alien-supporter, and if you're not a supporter, you would have no trouble whatsoever going in the battle against them.
yes.1: Defeat 100 #r#o4230118##k aliens that have invaded the area around Omega Sector. These guys can be found in #b#m221040300##k and #b#m221040400##k. I'll be waiting for you!

no.0: Hmmm... so it wasn't really an accident, but rather, you ARE an alien-supporter? I'll try to believe that's not true. If you want to change your mind, then talk to me.

1.0: Hoh... you did defeat all the #b#o4230118#s#k like I asked you to do. It was a difficult task, for sure, but I guess you really wanted to restore the faith in you, right? Alright... I'll tell the people upstairs that you are indeed a friend of the Omega Sector. Oh, and here's a small reward for your job well done.

yes.0: Did you receive #b1 #t1032020##k? I hope it helps in your adventures. Guess there won't be any help for an alien ever again... When you get a chance, please come see me. I just know that I will need your help.

mob.0: It seems like you haven't finished my mission yet. You must defeat 100 #b#o4230118##k aliens if you want our trust back.
